get_code_neighbors.name: get_code_neighbors
get_code_neighbors.description: Retrieve structural neighbors of one canonical node ID from the stored graph. Leave edge_type unset for the all-path task. A truncated neighborhood cannot support a completeness claim.

get_code_subgraph.name: get_code_subgraph
get_code_subgraph.description: Retrieve the stored edges between the supplied canonical node IDs.

graph_find_paths.name: graph_find_paths
graph_find_paths.description: Enumerate bounded node-simple paths in the stored undirected adjacency for each ordered source and target pair. Inspect the returned completeness flag before claiming completeness.

submit_graph_answer.name: submit_graph_answer
submit_graph_answer.description: Submit all distinct supported paths and whether the delivered evidence establishes that the set is exhaustive.

execute_python.name: execute_python
execute_python.description: Execute stateless Python standard-library code in an isolated container. Read-only input globals: question and observations (all graph tool attempts delivered so far as name/arguments/result). Print values to stdout. No host files or network. Prior Python variables/files do not persist. No graph access except supplied observations. Combined serialized input <=1MiB and depth<=64; overflow is an explicit error. Output JSON <=64000 characters.
